```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(networkD3)
library(pins)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

```

## Load deal history data

Pinned via [HubSpot Deal ETL](https://connect.procogia.com/content/19772643-5fc6-49c3-9fc9-c49a85835915)


```{r}
board <- board_connect()
deals <- board |> pin_read("deals")
deal_history <- board |> pin_read("deal_history")
```


```{r}
cat("deals:", nrow(deals), "\n")
cat("deal history records:", nrow(deal_history), "\n")

deals |> 
    mutate(`Year Created` = year(created_date)) |>
    count(`Year Created`) |> 
    gt::gt() 
```

## Sankey diagram

```{r}
closed_after <- ymd("2025-01-01")
created_after <- ymd("2025-01-01")
ignore_after <- today()
open_deals <- deals |>
  filter(close_date >= closed_after, created_date >= created_after)


# Create transitions from deal_history
transitions_raw <- deal_history |>
  filter(deal_id %in% open_deals$deal_id) |>
  filter(ts < ignore_after) |>
  mutate(stage_label = ifelse(is.na(stage_label), stage_id, stage_label)) |>
  mutate(
    stage_label = ifelse(
      str_detect(stage_label, '^[0-9]+$'),
      'UKNOWN',
      stage_label
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(deal_id, ts) |>
  group_by(deal_id) |>
  mutate(next_stage = lead(stage_label), this_stage = stage_label) |>
  filter(is.na(next_stage) | next_stage != stage_label | row_number() == 1) |>
  mutate(day_calc = as.numeric(difftime(lead(ts), ts, units = "days"))) |>
  group_by(deal_id, stage_label) |>
  mutate(days_in_stage = cumsum(day_calc)) |>
  group_by(deal_id) |>
  filter(row_number() != 1) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(!is.na(next_stage))

transitions_invalid <- transitions_raw |>
  filter(
    stage_label %in%
      c('UKNOWN', 'Closed Lost', 'Closed Won') |
      next_stage %in% c('UKNOWN', 'Qualification')
  ) |>
  pull(deal_id) |>
  unique()

transitions <- transitions_raw |>
  filter(!deal_id %in% transitions_invalid) |>
  group_by(stage_label, next_stage) |>
  summarise(
    value = n(),
    avg_days_in_stage = mean(days_in_stage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )


# Create nodes
nodes <- data.frame(
  name = unique(c(transitions$stage_label, transitions$next_stage)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(id = row_number() - 1)

# Create links with node IDs
links <- transitions |>
  left_join(nodes, by = c("stage_label" = "name")) |>
  rename(source = id) |>
  left_join(nodes, by = c("next_stage" = "name")) |>
  rename(target = id) |>
  select(source, target, value)

# Create sankey diagram
sankeyNetwork(
  Links = links,
  Nodes = nodes,
  Source = "source",
  Target = "target",
  Value = "value",
  NodeID = "name",
  fontSize = 12,
  nodeWidth = 30
)

# report date filters and number of deals
cat("Deals created after:", as.character(created_after), "\n")
cat("Deals closing after:", as.character(closed_after), "\n")
cat("Ignoring deal history after:", as.character(ignore_after), "\n")
```

## Deals with Invalid Transitions
```{r}
# View invalid transitions
bad_transitions <- transitions_raw |>
  filter(deal_id %in% transitions_invalid) |>
  group_by(stage_label, next_stage) |>
  summarise(
    value = n(),
    avg_days_in_stage = mean(days_in_stage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )


# Create nodes
bad_nodes <- data.frame(
  name = unique(c(bad_transitions$stage_label, bad_transitions$next_stage)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(id = row_number() - 1)

# Create links with node IDs
bad_links <- bad_transitions |>
  left_join(bad_nodes, by = c("stage_label" = "name")) |>
  rename(source = id) |>
  left_join(bad_nodes, by = c("next_stage" = "name")) |>
  rename(target = id) |>
  select(source, target, value)

# Create sankey diagram
sankeyNetwork(
  Links = bad_links,
  Nodes = bad_nodes,
  Source = "source",
  Target = "target",
  Value = "value",
  NodeID = "name",
  fontSize = 12,
  nodeWidth = 30
)

if (nrow(bad_transitions) > 0) {
  cat("Deals with invalid transitions:", length(transitions_invalid), "\n")
  cat("Invalid transitions:\n")
  print(bad_transitions)
} else {
  cat("No invalid transitions found.\n")
}
```

## Active Deals by Stage


```{r}
stages <- c("Qualification", "Exploration", "Proposal", "Forecasted", "Closed Won", "Closed Lost") |> rev()

view_date <- today() - months(3)
open_deals <- deals |>
  filter(created_date <= view_date,
         is.na(close_date) | close_date >= view_date) 

last_history <- deal_history |>
  filter(deal_id %in% open_deals$deal_id) |>
  group_by(deal_id) |>
  filter(ts <= view_date + hours(16)) |>
  filter(ts == max(ts)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(deal_id, stage = stage_label)

deal_snapshot <- open_deals |>
  select(deal_id, deal_name, amount, created_date, close_date, stage_label) |>
  left_join(last_history, by = "deal_id") |> 
  mutate(days_open = as.numeric(difftime(view_date, created_date, units = "days"))) |> 
  select(deal_name, amount, created_date, days_open, stage_on_date = stage, latest_stage = stage_label) |> 
  arrange(created_date) |> 
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         stage_on_date = ifelse(is.na(stage_on_date), latest_stage, stage_on_date)
         )

deal_plt <- deal_snapshot |> 
  mutate(stage_on_date = factor(stage_on_date, levels = stages),
         latest_stage = factor(latest_stage, levels = stages)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = stage_on_date, x = days_open, color = latest_stage,
  deal_name = deal_name, id = id)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = amount), alpha = 0.7) 

ggplotly(deal_plt, tooltip = c("id", "deal_name", "amount", "created_date", "days_open", "stage_on_date", "latest_stage"))
```
